body.en: A try statement can end with a finally clause. Its statements execute every time: when the try succeeds, when an exception is caught, and even when the exception is not handled. It is placed after all except clauses and the else clause, and is commonly used to close files or release resources. If the exception is not handled, finally runs first and then the exception is passed on.

points.en: Runs whether or not an exception occurs
Unhandled exception: finally runs, then the exception is re-raised
